verdict.rationale: E2B documents continuous sandbox sessions of up to 24 hours on Pro (only 1 hour on Base), with an adjustable timeout via setTimeout/set_timeout. For longer workloads it points to pause/resume, which preserves filesystem and memory, and paused sandboxes are kept indefinitely. So multi-hour runs are covered, but multi-day work requires suspending execution rather than staying live. Missing for 10: continuous running beyond 24 hours, long sessions on the Base tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running stability.
